title: Leveraging Domain Knowledge for Inclusive and Bias-aware Humanitarian Response Entry Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual text substitution by swapping gender-specific and neutral keywords (e.g., female, male, neutral equivalents) in input text, followed by calculating the shift in the model's predicted label probabilities (P-Shift and Tag-Shift metrics).
